still_flagged.name: Fighter Plane
still_flagged.why: It's a military combat aircraft, which is a weapon platform. It carries the most direct associations with war and bombing, and that could upset players who have lived through conflict.

still_flagged.name: Submarine
still_flagged.why: A grey military submarine is a warship. It evokes naval combat and is more weapon-like than the other gear in the set. A yellow or cartoon exploration sub would be safer.

still_flagged.name: Poker Chips
still_flagged.why: Casino chips depict gambling. Some faiths and cultures object to gambling, and parents may not want it promoted to children in an all-ages game.
